item.title: Stanford Study: NVIDIA B200 Delivers 9x Energy Efficiency vs AMD MI350X
item.description:
Stanford researchers introduced the 'Joules-to-GDP' metric to quantify the economic return of AI chips relative to energy consumption in real-world professional tasks. The study found that when running identical models, the NVIDIA B200 delivered over 4x the dollar value and 9x the expert time saved per unit of energy compared to the AMD MI350X. This highlights how hardware selection critically determines AI economic efficiency under power constraints.

原文标题：斯坦福研究：NVIDIA B200 能效比 AMD MI350X 高 9 倍

Why it matters：提供了具体的芯片能效对比数据和新颖的经济评估指标，对算力选型具有直接参考价值。

item.title: Stanford Proposes J2G Framework Showing Small Models Yield Higher Economic Value per Joule
item.description:
Stanford researchers introduced the 'Joules-to-GDP' (J2G) framework to quantify the net economic value generated per joule of energy consumed by AI tasks. Experiments on the GDPval benchmark revealed that smaller open-source models (e.g., Gemma 4 31B) deliver significantly higher economic returns per unit of energy compared to larger models, despite lower absolute output. The study highlights that scaling up hardware often yields diminishing speed gains relative to energy costs, offering new efficiency-based criteria for model selection in power-constrained environments.

原文标题：斯坦福提出 J2G 框架 揭示小模型能效经济价值更高

Why it matters：提出了量化的能效-经济价值评估新范式，数据详实，对当前高耗能大模型趋势具有直接的纠偏与指导意义。

item.description:

He outlined five priorities including worker protections and data center development to address public anxiety, though OpenAI has not provided further specifics on these proposals.

item.title: Anthropic Uses Claude to Map First Bacterial Vault Particle Structure
item.description:
Anthropic's biology lab used Claude to discover and map the first 3D structure of vault particles in bacteria and their viruses. By driving the wet-lab pipeline directly, the AI reduced particle isolation from 3 days to 90 minutes and generated a preliminary structural model in just 34 hours, significantly accelerating a process that previously took weeks.

原文标题：Anthropic 用 Claude 首次解析细菌 Vault 蛋白结构

Why it matters：展示了大模型在自动化科学发现与湿实验闭环中的实质性突破，具有极高的行业标杆意义。

item.title: Coherent Q1 Revenue Jumps 50% Driven by AI Data Center Optical Interconnects
item.description:

The beat was driven by strong growth in data center and telecom segments (82% of revenue), highlighting the direct benefits of the shift from copper to optical interconnects in AI infrastructure.

item.title: Pew Survey Reveals Deep Divide in US Public Trust of AI Healthcare
item.description:
A new Pew Research survey highlights a stark divide in American public opinion on AI in healthcare. While higher-income adults are optimistic about improved care, lower-income and younger groups fear negative outcomes. Although most accept AI for translation, only 3% would allow autonomous AI diagnosis, with widespread concerns over data privacy and the erosion of the doctor-patient relationship.

原文标题：皮尤调查：美国民众对 AI 医疗应用态度两极分化

Why it matters：揭示了 AI 落地医疗场景时面临的社会信任危机与阶层认知差异，为行业合规与伦理设计提供重要参考。

item.description:

While public acceptance exists for auxiliary uses like translation, there is deep pessimism regarding data privacy, the doctor-patient relationship, and trust in oversight, particularly among younger adults who increasingly doubt AI will improve outcomes.

item.description:
